Headline max 6 words, bold sans-serif (Montserrat or Poppins Bold), at least 90 px tall on a 2000 px canvas.
Max 3 callouts, max 5 words each, at least 60 px tall. Use icons next to callouts.
Keep text in the top or left third; keep 100 px safe margin on every side.
Same layout, fonts, icon set and colors on all 8 products so the brand looks like one family.

colors.note: If PETME2 already has logo colors, use those instead and keep the same 2 accents rule.

rules: Use ONLY the on-image text in this plan. Do not add claims, numbers, 'best', '#1', 'premium', 'luxury', 'vet approved', health claims, warranty badges, prices, or competitor names/products.
Do not show features the product does not have (see each product's 'do not show' list).
Phone screens must be real app screenshots from the owner (no fake UI, no app store badges).
Deliver layered PSD/Figma + JPG exports named ASIN.SLOT.jpg (e.g. B0DR7FCLZR.PT05.jpg) so they upload to the right slot.
what_owner_must_send: 1 sample unit of each product (or high-res photos)
A short phone video of each product running
